description:
We welcome motivated teammates who can contribute in one or more of the following areas:

Frontend / UI-UX Developer: React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, interactive mapping (Leaflet / MapLibre), or scientific plotting (Plotly.js).

Earth Science / Data Analyst: Someone passionate about climate science, hydrology, or atmospheric physics to help interpret NASA variables (MODIS, GLDAS, MERRA-2) and craft compelling scientific case studies.
